shortBulletSummary: US July CPI hit 3.4% YoY as expected, easing Fed rate hike concerns while Bitcoin stayed flat near $64,000.
ETH gained 1.4% and tested resistance levels, backed by ETF inflows and institutional demand.
SEC evaluates tailored rules for crypto while the CLARITY Act encounters delays until September.
Uncertainty around a US-Iran deal concerning the Strait of Hormuz raised oil prices and risk-off sentiment.
